-- Final query with clean column names
WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, b.over_id, b.ball_id, b.innings_no,
        b.striker, b.non_striker,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as batsman_runs,
        COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) as extra_runs,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT *,
        LAG(striker) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as prev_striker,
        LAG(non_striker) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as prev_non_striker
    FROM ball_data
),
with_partner_flag AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_striker IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN (LEAST(striker, non_striker) = LEAST(prev_striker, prev_non_striker) AND GREATEST(striker, non_striker) = GREATEST(prev_striker, prev_non_striker)) THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END as new_partnership
    FROM with_prev
),
partnership_ids AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM(new_partnership) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as partnership_id
    FROM with_partner_flag
),
partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, innings_no, partnership_id,
        LEAST(striker, non_striker) as bat1,
        GREATEST(striker, non_striker) as bat2,
        SUM(total_runs) as partnership_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker = LEAST(striker, non_striker) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) as bat1_batsman_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker = GREATEST(striker, non_striker) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) as bat2_batsman_runs
    FROM partnership_ids
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, partnership_id, LEAST(striker, non_striker), GREATEST(striker, non_striker)
),
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
    FROM partnerships
    GROUP BY match_id
),
top_partnerships AS (
    SELECT p.match_id, p.bat1, p.bat2, p.partnership_runs, p.bat1_batsman_runs, p.bat2_batsman_runs
    FROM partnerships p
    JOIN max_partnerships m ON p.match_id = m.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = m.max_runs
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs > bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat1
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs < bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat2
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat1 ELSE bat2 END
        END as player1,
        CASE 
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs > bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat2
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs < bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat1
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat2 ELSE bat1 END
        END as player2,
        CAST(CASE 
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs > bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat1_batsman_runs
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs < bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat2_batsman_runs
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat1_batsman_runs ELSE bat2_batsman_runs END
        END AS INTEGER) as player1_score,
        CAST(CASE 
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs > bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat2_batsman_runs
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs < bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat1_batsman_runs
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat2_batsman_runs ELSE bat1_batsman_runs END
        END AS INTEGER) as player2_score,
        CAST(partnership_runs AS INTEGER) as partnership_runs
    FROM top_partnerships
)
